title: Mathematics Practice Test 2 - Mathematics - Number Sense (Square Roots)
subject: Mathematics

questions.q:
As shown, the number line between 0 and 8 is divided into 6 segments of equal length by points A through E. Which of the following statements about $\sqrt{8}$ is true?

<svg viewBox="0 0 300 80" width="300" height="80" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <polygon points="15,40 25,35 25,45" fill="black"/>
  <polygon points="285,40 275,35 275,45" fill="black"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="40" x2="275" y2="40" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="35" x2="40" y2="45" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="73.3" y1="35" x2="73.3" y2="45" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="106.6" y1="35" x2="106.6" y2="45" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="35" x2="140" y2="45" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="173.3" y1="35" x2="173.3" y2="45" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="206.6" y1="35" x2="206.6" y2="45" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="240" y1="35" x2="240" y2="45" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="36" y="60">0</text>
  <text x="69" y="60">A</text>
  <text x="102" y="60">B</text>
  <text x="136" y="60">C</text>
  <text x="169" y="60">D</text>
  <text x="202" y="60">E</text>
  <text x="236" y="60">8</text>
</svg>
questions.explain: The distance from 0 to 8 is divided into 6 equal segments. Each segment has a length of $\frac{8}{6} = \frac{4}{3} \approx 1.33$. The values of the points are: $A \approx 1.33$, $B = 2.67$, $C = 4$, $D \approx 5.33$, $E \approx 6.67$. We need to estimate $\sqrt{8}$. Since $2^2 = 4$ and $3^2 = 9$, $\sqrt{8}$ is slightly less than 3 (approx $2.83$). This value falls between point B (2.67) and point C (4).
